name: Bulgaria
notes: Depth: seed (R001, 2026-11-04). National level only. 8 supporters, 11 evidence rows: two union confederations (KNSB, Podkrepa) and their officials, and five Socialist MEPs or ex-MEPs on two European Parliament roll calls (one now sits in the National Assembly). No MP bill, party programme or economist's recommendation for a net wealth tax was found; Bulgaria's debate is about replacing the 10% flat income tax with a progressive one, which is out of definition. Register: 28 oblasti (NUTS 3) and 265 obshtini (LAU), Eurostat GISCO 2024. Map: Eurostat GISCO LAU 2024 and NUTS 2024, CC BY 4.0, codes are Eurostat LAU (national NSI codes) and NUTS. Seats: 52nd National Assembly, 240 seats, from parliament.bg open data. capital.bg blocks scripts and was not read.
